description: Validate an EU VAT number against the European Commission's official VIES service: checks the country-specific format first, then asks VIES whether the number is active for intra-EU trade and returns the registered business name and address when the member state shares them. Covers all EU states plus XI (Northern Ireland); Greece accepts GR or EL. If VIES or the member state's service is down, the call errors (API-key credits are refunded) instead of guessing.

countryCode.description: 2-letter EU country code if vatNumber has no prefix, e.g. DE

vatNumber.description: VAT number, ideally with its country prefix, e.g. IE6388047V or DE 123456789

name: vat_validate
